module.name: Debugging
module.description: Helps obtain information about crash or freeze of application not running under debugger.

submodule.name: MapFile
submodule.description: Helps retrieve informations about address in program from *.map file.

submodule.name: Imexhnd
submodule.description: Write information about application context and crash context (call stack, registers etc.) into report file.

submodule.name: DebugTrap
submodule.description: Detection and report of application freeze.

use_interface.description: Generic informations about application (version, context etc.). Application itself is responsible for nondefault implementation.
